1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product; and __performing said generating step using a computing device__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __using a computing device to read__ the unique identifier from the package.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __using a computing device to receive__ information stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

4. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising: searching a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier.

5. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 4, wherein searching the data store comprises transmitting the unique identifier to the data store over a network.

6. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form.

7. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving the at least use information from the data store.

8. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of a product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving user information regarding use of the product from __a user via a user device__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving an input through __the__ user device.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving the user information regarding use of the product stored in a radio frequency identification tag __associated with the user__.

12. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving information from a secondary device.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium __associated with a user__ and a list of users.

14. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual.

15. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving a user profile, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information based at least partially on the user profile.

16. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising generating an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

17. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received.

18. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying __a user of the product__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier; and generating a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier.

21. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 20, further comprising generating one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, wherein __the user identified by the second unique identifier comprises a second user providing the product to the first user identified by the first unique identifier__, the method further comprising: storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to __the role of the second user__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for __a particular user identified by the unique identifier__.

25. (Currently Amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to receive __a__ unique identifier identifying a package containing the product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the user device further configured to communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information, __wherein the user device comprises a processor and a memory storing instructions for performing the receiving and generating steps__.

26. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive __a__ unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network, __wherein the computing device comprises a processor and memory for executing instructions to perform the receiving and generating steps__.

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: __a processor and memory configured to receive__ a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and __the processor and memory configured to generate__ at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

28. (Previously Presented) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions for: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.
